notes: State rate 2.95% for 2026, falling to 2.90% in 2027 (DOR Rates, Fees & Penalties; Departmental Notice #1).

Personal exemption $1,000 per taxpayer/spouse (Departmental Notice #1, Table A). Not modeled: $1,500 dependent exemptions, extra exemptions for age 65+/blind, renter's and other deductions, Indiana add-backs, and credits.
County income tax is modeled with a representative rate (see localIncomeTax); actual county rates range from 0.5% (Porter) to 3.0% (Randolph).

seDeduction.note: Inherited: Indiana AGI starts from federal AGI (IRC conformity updated to Jan 1, 2026 by SEA 243-2026).

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is below AGI and is not part of Indiana AGI.

localIncomeTax.note: All 92 Indiana counties levy a county income tax, applied to the same base as the state tax (Indiana AGI less exemptions) and determined by county of residence on Jan 1. Rates in Departmental Notice #1 (effective Oct 1, 2026) range from 0.5% to 3.0%; the modeled 1.97% is the median of the 92 county rates (e.g., Marion 2.02%, Lake 1.5%, Allen 1.59%, Hamilton 1.1%). Users should substitute their own county rate.

modeled.label: Indiana county income tax (median county rate)

estimatedTax.threshold: Generally required if you will owe $1,000 or more in combined state and county tax for the year that is not covered by withholding.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Avoid the 10% underpayment penalty by paying at least 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's tax (110% if prior-year federal AGI exceeded $150,000, or $75,000 MFS); use IT-2210/IT-2210A.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: Articles of Organization: $75 filed electronically or $100 on paper (IC 23-0.5-9-19; State Form 49459 lists $100 paper fee). INBiz may add an online processing/convenience fee on top of the statutory amount.
businessCosts.annualReportFee: Business Entity Report every two years (biennial): $20 statutory fee filed electronically (plus any INBiz processing fee) or $50 on paper for a for-profit entity (IC 23-0.5-9-34; IC 23-0.5-2-13).
